scene: You unroll the pigeon's tiny parchment note, revealing an ink map.
picture: A first-person close-up view of the player's hands holding an unrolled cream parchment note. Centre shows a handwritten three-line riddle in dark purple ink. Right displays a delicate ink illustration of a rooftop windmill. Left holds a tiny polished brass ring attached to the corner with red thread.
shown: a tiny cryptic riddle penned across the centre of the parchment
a detailed windmill icon drawn on the right side of the parchment
a miniature brass ring fastened to the left edge of the parchment

variants.scene: You hold open the aged parchment to examine its curious message.
The crisp note crinkles softly between your fingers as you look.
A neat sketch of a windmill sits beside strange, looped handwriting.
